patterns.note: Content is primarily centered within a wide canvas, with horizontal divider lines featuring '+' symbols at their ends to delineate major sections.
Consistent use of elegant serif fonts for all textual content, contrasted with a highly decorative, script-like font for specific call-to-action phrases.
A deeply monochromatic color scheme dominates, using a dark forest green background with light off-white text and subtle lighter green tones for line art and accents.
Content sections and individual project listings reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they scroll into the viewport.
The top navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid background as it sticks to the top of the page.
Intricate, architectural line-art illustrations serve as large, thematic background elements for content groupings, particularly in the 'Work projects' section.

technique_notes: The sticky header is implemented to shrink in height and change its background from transparent to solid as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Content sections and individual items within them are revealed using scroll-triggered CSS keyframe animations, causing them to fade in and translate slightly upwards as they enter the viewport.
Large, detailed line-art illustrations are used as static background elements that scroll with the page, providing a consistent visual motif without parallaxing.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant serif headings are significantly larger and more decorative (~3-4x body) than the smaller, refined serif body text, with a distinct script font for call-outs.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in the hero and around main content blocks, balanced in project grids, and dense for footer links, creating an overall spacious feel.

standout: The site's design is highly distinctive due to its unique integration of intricate, architectural line-art illustrations as structural background elements for content sections. This, combined with a deeply monochromatic color palette and elegant, almost calligraphic typography, creates a sophisticated, old-world, and highly artistic aesthetic that sets it apart from typical modern portfolios.
